Future<void> main() async {

  try {
    final req = await createOcrRequestFromJson(json: '{"document":{"type":"document_url","url":"https://example.com/contract-test.pdf"},"model":"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest"}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.ocr(req: req);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
